But he couldn't offer any concrete suggestions, apart from the possibility that high ground near this little Wiltshire town

Two people described hearing or seeing strange things in the sky.
One of them, Mrs. Rachel Atwell, said that whatever it was, it scared her out of her wits.
She told me afterwards that she'd seen a bright ball giving off a loud, high-pitched sound,
and the only reason she'd gone to the meeting was the fact that it scared her out of her life
when she wanted to find an explanation.
Then the head postmaster said that his house was surrounded early on Christmas morning
by a terrible sound as though all his tiles were being lifted off and put back on again.
But later on, when he had a look, they were undisturbed.
What it is, well, we're not much the wiser tonight,
but there is a talk, Peter, of setting up a listening post here in Warminster.
